title: W3Schools: Python String Formatting
description: Given `name` and `count`, return the formatted string: 'Hello, {name}! You have {count} unread messages.'
constraints:
1 <= len(name) <= 100, 0 <= count <= 10^6
• Time: O(1) | Space: O(1)
starter_code:
def format_message(name: str, count: int) -> str:
    pass

visible_tests.expected: Hello, Alice! You have 5 unread messages.
Hello, Bob! You have 0 unread messages.

hidden_tests.expected: Hello, User! You have 100 unread messages.

solution:
def format_message(name: str, count: int) -> str:
    return f'Hello, {name}! You have {count} unread messages.'
explanation: f-string template interpolation in O(1) time.
